Parham has been an innovator during his career, notably pioneering the first “Car-X Tire” concept. | Beginning his career as the manager of his father’s automotive repair shop in the early 1990s, Parham became CEO and expanded the business to a 17-store portfolio across the Midwest. During this time, he also served on the Car-X Tire & Auto franchise Board of Directors. In 2017, Parham sold the entire portfolio to Monro, Inc. (NASDAQ: MNRO), the largest publicly traded company in the industry. | Parham’s family came to the U.S. under political asylum to escape the Islamic revolution in Iran in 1980. Parham earned his MBA at the University of Illinois Gies College of Business in 1999, where he was the youngest member of his class. | Parham enjoys tennis, golf, and spending time traveling with his wife and 3 daughters. Parham is also an avid writer, and has published a book titled “Perfect Pain”. | VP of Sales & Operations | Dwayne Chaney | Dwayne has over 30 years of automotive experience. Prior to joining Left Lane Auto, Dwayne was a regional manager at Tire Discounters. Before his time at Tire Discounters, Dwayne spent 22 years at Monro, where he worked his way from store manager to regional manager, supervising 30+ locations. | Dwayne is a GM Certified Technician, and early in his career spent time as a lead technician at various dealerships. | Dwayne enjoys fishing and spending time with his 4 children. | VP of Accounting & Procurement | Jean Maple | Jean Maple serves as Vice President of Accounting & Procurement at Left Lane Auto, overseeing vendor relationships, sales tax compliance, and business licensing across the company’s locations. She also partners with the acquisition team and business owners to support smooth transitions and strengthen processes. Jean values teamwork, accountability, and practical solutions that support the company’s continued growth. | Outside of work, Jean enjoys spending time with her daughters, riding her motorcycle, traveling, and reading. She is also completing her bachelor’s degree in accounting. | Partner | Jeff Beasley | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Jeff was the President of Clay Dooley Tire and Auto which he purchased in 2018. At that time, Clay Dooley was generating $800,000 in revenue and $40,000 in net profit. When Jeff sold Clay Dooley to Left Lane Auto in 2021, the operation generated over $2 million in sales and approximately $400,000 in net profit. | Jeff’s career included a 12-year stint with Nona, Inc., beginning as a store manager and culminating as vice president. At Nona, Jeff specialized in operations and finance and helped Nona grow from 4 locations to 17 locations throughout the Midwest. | Jeff also worked for Monro, Inc. as a District Manager. His responsibilities included oversight of day-to-day operations for 35+ stores, and implementation of Monro, Inc. policies and procedures. | Jeff is an Automotive Service Excellence Master Technician, a General Motors certified Technician, and holds over 20 other mechanical certifications. Jeff earned a Bachelor of Business Administration from Illinois State University. | Jeff enjoys building and racing sprint cars and spending time with his wife and 2 daughters. | VP of Operations | Tripp Peek | With more than three decades of experience in the tire and automotive industry, Tripp brings a wealth of knowledge and leadership experience to the team. He began his career as a tire technician with Kauffman Tire in 1998 and spent the next 25 years growing through the organization, eventually leading stores and regions throughout the Atlanta area. He later spent more than six years with Tire Discounters, taking on several different roles on the Operations side of the business and gaining valuable experience in leadership, team development, and day-to-day automotive operations. | A graduate of Kennesaw State University with a bachelor’s degree in education, Tripp brings a people-focused approach to leadership and a passion for helping teams succeed. Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his wife, Tina, and their two children, Jack and Presley. The family loves being outdoors, especially hunting and fishing, and they’re also big Atlanta Braves fans. | VP of Customer Relations & Accounts Receivable | Vickie Royal | Vickie Royal bringing extensive experience in fixed operations, customer relations, accounts receivable, and office management. Throughout her career with Left Lane Auto, she has held several leadership roles, including Store Manager and Regional Manager, before stepping into her current position overseeing the Customer Relations and Accounts Receivable departments. Her hands-on experience, dedication, and people-first approach make her a valued leader who is committed to supporting her team, strengthening customer relationships, and helping the organization succeed. | Born and raised in Greenville, Georgia, Vickie began building her family in Auburn, Alabama, where she became a proud mother of four and, eventually, a grandmother to five wonderful grandchildren. Today, she lives in Prattville, Alabama, with her husband, Charley, their two dogs, and two cats. Outside of work, Vickie enjoys traveling with her husband, spending time with family, fishing, camping, listening to all genres of music, and curling up with a good book on a rainy day. A devoted Auburn and Georgia football fan, she also loves joining her grandchildren in whatever activities they enjoy. Whether she’s leading her team, cheering on her favorite football teams, or making memories with her family, Vickie brings warmth, loyalty, and enthusiasm to everything she does. | Outside of work, family is at the center of everything she does. She enjoys traveling with her husband, spending time with her children and grandchildren, fishing, camping, listening to music, and curling up with a good book on a rainy day. A loyal Auburn and Georgia football fan, she also loves joining in on the activities her grandchildren enjoy. Whether supporting her team at work or making memories with family, she brings warmth, dedication, and enthusiasm to everything she does. | Partner | Derek Dimke | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Derek was a Senior Account Director at LinkedIn, where he was a member of LinkedIn’s leadership committee which focused on sales management and employee engagement. | Prior to LinkedIn, Derek worked as an associate at Goldman Sachs, advising business owners and executives on investment strategy and risk mitigation. Additionally, Derek’s career included a three-year stint as a kicker in the National Football League. | Derek earned his bachelor’s degree in finance and his MBA from the University of Illinois Gies College of Business. While attending the University of Illinois, he was a four-year starter, captain, and Distinguished Scholar on the football team. | Derek enjoys golfing and traveling with his wife and daughters. | Vice President of Inventory & Technology | Rob Webb | Rob Webb serves as Vice President of Inventory & Technology at Left Lane Auto, overseeing tire inventory across the company’s locations and managing technology solutions at both the shop and corporate levels. An ASE Master Technician and graduate of Universal Technical Institute, Rob combines hands-on automotive expertise with technical knowledge to support efficient operations and the continued growth of Left Lane Auto. | Outside of work, Rob enjoys camping, following Formula 1, and spending time with his son and daughter. | Senior Director of Acquisitions | Brent McKinnon | As Senior Director of Acquisitions at Left Lane Auto, Brent McKinnon plays an important role in supporting the company’s continued growth and expansion. He is passionate about building relationships and helping move the organization forward as it welcomes new businesses into the Left Lane Auto family. | Outside of work, family is at the heart of Brent’s life. He loves watching his son play baseball and cheering on his wife and daughter as they compete in barrel racing. An outdoor enthusiast, Brent especially enjoys spending time near the water, with the ocean being a favorite destination. His faith is also an important part of his life, and he enjoys spending weekends with family and friends gathered around a bonfire. Whether at work or at home, Brent values meaningful relationships, time with loved ones, and the things that matter most. | Partner | Kim Price | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Kim was the Corporate Office Manager of Nona, Inc., and part of the Accounting Team at Green Street Realty. subpages.text_content: About - Left Lane Auto | Skip to main content | Hit enter to search or ESC to close | Search | Close Search | Menu | Locations | About Us | Left Lane Auto Network | Success Stories | News & Insights | Our Team | Careers | Sell Your Shop | Careers | Contact Us | Home | » About | About Left Lane Auto | Dedicated to Getting You There. | Left Lane Auto is a tight-knit organization with decades of experience owning and operating successful automotive repair shops across the country. | We have a proven track record of innovation and success, and we continue to grow by partnering with business owners looking to sell their automotive repair or tire businesses. | No matter the size of your organization, Left Lane Auto has the resources and capital to make a deal happen on a timeline that works for you. | Whether you have one location or 20, we’re ready to have a confidential conversation. | Start a conversation | Our Mission | The mission of Left Lane Auto is centered around three groups who make our business possible: our customers, our employees, and business owners. | To Our Customers | Our mission is to provide the highest quality customer experience focused on creating a positive, family-like atmosphere at all locations. | To Our Employees | Our mission is to create a culture that promotes learning new skills, developing talents, and dreaming big. | To Business Owners | Our mission is to preserve the legacy they’ve built while offering peace of mind throughout the process. Our | Success Stories | reflect our commitment to creating thoughtful transitions that honor what owners have built. | Experience You Can Count On. | Our leadership team brings decades of combined experience in automotive repair, operations, finance, business development, marketing, sales, and entrepreneurship. | CEO & Founding Partner | Parham Parastaran | Parham is an entrepreneur with extensive experience purchasing and operating automotive repair and tire shops. Parham has been an innovator during his career, notably pioneering the first “Car-X Tire” concept. | Beginning his career as the manager of his father’s automotive repair shop in the early 1990s, Parham became CEO and expanded the business to a 17-store portfolio across the Midwest. During this time, he also served on the Car-X Tire & Auto franchise Board of Directors. In 2017, Parham sold the entire portfolio to Monro, Inc. (NASDAQ: MNRO), the largest publicly traded company in the industry. | Parham’s family came to the U.S. under political asylum to escape the Islamic revolution in Iran in 1980. Parham earned his MBA at the University of Illinois Gies College of Business in 1999, where he was the youngest member of his class. | Parham enjoys tennis, golf, and spending time traveling with his wife and 3 daughters. Parham is also an avid writer, and has published a book titled “Perfect Pain”. | VP of Sales & Operations | Dwayne Chaney | Dwayne has over 30 years of automotive experience. Prior to joining Left Lane Auto, Dwayne was a regional manager at Tire Discounters. Before his time at Tire Discounters, Dwayne spent 22 years at Monro, where he worked his way from store manager to regional manager, supervising 30+ locations. | Dwayne is a GM Certified Technician, and early in his career spent time as a lead technician at various dealerships. | Dwayne enjoys fishing and spending time with his 4 children. | VP of Accounting & Procurement | Jean Maple | Jean Maple serves as Vice President of Accounting & Procurement at Left Lane Auto, overseeing vendor relationships, sales tax compliance, and business licensing across the company’s locations. She also partners with the acquisition team and business owners to support smooth transitions and strengthen processes. Jean values teamwork, accountability, and practical solutions that support the company’s continued growth. | Outside of work, Jean enjoys spending time with her daughters, riding her motorcycle, traveling, and reading. She is also completing her bachelor’s degree in accounting. | Partner | Jeff Beasley | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Jeff was the President of Clay Dooley Tire and Auto which he purchased in 2018. At that time, Clay Dooley was generating $800,000 in revenue and $40,000 in net profit. When Jeff sold Clay Dooley to Left Lane Auto in 2021, the operation generated over $2 million in sales and approximately $400,000 in net profit. | Jeff’s career included a 12-year stint with Nona, Inc., beginning as a store manager and culminating as vice president. At Nona, Jeff specialized in operations and finance and helped Nona grow from 4 locations to 17 locations throughout the Midwest. | Jeff also worked for Monro, Inc. as a District Manager. His responsibilities included oversight of day-to-day operations for 35+ stores, and implementation of Monro, Inc. policies and procedures. | Jeff is an Automotive Service Excellence Master Technician, a General Motors certified Technician, and holds over 20 other mechanical certifications. Jeff earned a Bachelor of Business Administration from Illinois State University. | Jeff enjoys building and racing sprint cars and spending time with his wife and 2 daughters. | VP of Operations | Tripp Peek | With more than three decades of experience in the tire and automotive industry, Tripp brings a wealth of knowledge and leadership experience to the team. He began his career as a tire technician with Kauffman Tire in 1998 and spent the next 25 years growing through the organization, eventually leading stores and regions throughout the Atlanta area. He later spent more than six years with Tire Discounters, taking on several different roles on the Operations side of the business and gaining valuable experience in leadership, team development, and day-to-day automotive operations. | A graduate of Kennesaw State University with a bachelor’s degree in education, Tripp brings a people-focused approach to leadership and a passion for helping teams succeed. Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his wife, Tina, and their two children, Jack and Presley. The family loves being outdoors, especially hunting and fishing, and they’re also big Atlanta Braves fans. | VP of Customer Relations & Accounts Receivable | Vickie Royal | Vickie Royal bringing extensive experience in fixed operations, customer relations, accounts receivable, and office management. Throughout her career with Left Lane Auto, she has held several leadership roles, including Store Manager and Regional Manager, before stepping into her current position overseeing the Customer Relations and Accounts Receivable departments. Her hands-on experience, dedication, and people-first approach make her a valued leader who is committed to supporting her team, strengthening customer relationships, and helping the organization succeed. | Born and raised in Greenville, Georgia, Vickie began building her family in Auburn, Alabama, where she became a proud mother of four and, eventually, a grandmother to five wonderful grandchildren. Today, she lives in Prattville, Alabama, with her husband, Charley, their two dogs, and two cats. Outside of work, Vickie enjoys traveling with her husband, spending time with family, fishing, camping, listening to all genres of music, and curling up with a good book on a rainy day. A devoted Auburn and Georgia football fan, she also loves joining her grandchildren in whatever activities they enjoy. Whether she’s leading her team, cheering on her favorite football teams, or making memories with her family, Vickie brings warmth, loyalty, and enthusiasm to everything she does. | Outside of work, family is at the center of everything she does. She enjoys traveling with her husband, spending time with her children and grandchildren, fishing, camping, listening to music, and curling up with a good book on a rainy day. A loyal Auburn and Georgia football fan, she also loves joining in on the activities her grandchildren enjoy. Whether supporting her team at work or making memories with family, she brings warmth, dedication, and enthusiasm to everything she does. | Partner | Derek Dimke | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Derek was a Senior Account Director at LinkedIn, where he was a member of LinkedIn’s leadership committee which focused on sales management and employee engagement. | Prior to LinkedIn, Derek worked as an associate at Goldman Sachs, advising business owners and executives on investment strategy and risk mitigation. Additionally, Derek’s career included a three-year stint as a kicker in the National Football League. | Derek earned his bachelor’s degree in finance and his MBA from the University of Illinois Gies College of Business. While attending the University of Illinois, he was a four-year starter, captain, and Distinguished Scholar on the football team. | Derek enjoys golfing and traveling with his wife and daughters. | Vice President of Inventory & Technology | Rob Webb | Rob Webb serves as Vice President of Inventory & Technology at Left Lane Auto, overseeing tire inventory across the company’s locations and managing technology solutions at both the shop and corporate levels. An ASE Master Technician and graduate of Universal Technical Institute, Rob combines hands-on automotive expertise with technical knowledge to support efficient operations and the continued growth of Left Lane Auto. | Outside of work, Rob enjoys camping, following Formula 1, and spending time with his son and daughter. | Senior Director of Acquisitions | Brent McKinnon | As Senior Director of Acquisitions at Left Lane Auto, Brent McKinnon plays an important role in supporting the company’s continued growth and expansion. He is passionate about building relationships and helping move the organization forward as it welcomes new businesses into the Left Lane Auto family. | Outside of work, family is at the heart of Brent’s life. He loves watching his son play baseball and cheering on his wife and daughter as they compete in barrel racing. An outdoor enthusiast, Brent especially enjoys spending time near the water, with the ocean being a favorite destination. His faith is also an important part of his life, and he enjoys spending weekends with family and friends gathered around a bonfire. Whether at work or at home, Brent values meaningful relationships, time with loved ones, and the things that matter most. | Partner | Kim Price | Before joining Left Lane Auto, Kim was the Corporate Office Manager of Nona, Inc., and part of the Accounting Team at Green Street Realty. She has extensive experience in management, accounting, and people management. | Kim also held leadership positions at Target and Ameritech, and served as treasurer for the local chapter of the Communication Workers of America. | Kim enjoys traveling and spending time with her family and labradoodle, Milo. | Director of Marketing | Stephanie Bendlin | Stephanie Bendlin serves as Director of Marketing at Left Lane Auto, where she leads marketing strategy and initiatives focused on driving growth, strengthening brand awareness, and supporting the company’s continued expansion. With more than a decade of marketing experience, including roles with Northwest Bank and Thunder Creek Equipment, Stephanie brings expertise in digital marketing, social media, search engine optimization (SEO), website development, advertising, and campaign management. She is passionate about building strong brands, developing effective marketing strategies, and helping businesses connect with their customers and communities. | Before transitioning into marketing, Stephanie held brand management roles with Victoria’s Secret and Urban Outfitters, where she focused on sales performance, team development, and customer experience. She earned her bachelor’s degree from Western Illinois University and gained early industry experience through internships with Marie Claire magazine and MILK Studios in New York City. | Outside of work, Stephanie enjoys making memories with her family and cheering on the Chicago Bears! | Dedicated to Getting You There. | Contact Us | Left Lane Auto, LLC. | 2202 Fox Drive, Suite B. | Champaign, IL 61820 | Locations | About Us | Sell Your Shop | News & Insights | Left Lane Auto Network | Careers | (217) 607-1069 | info@leftlaneautollc.com | © 2026 . Here’s What to Expect During an Acquisition | Selling an automotive repair or tire business is a major decision. For many owners, the business represents years—or even generations—of hard work, relationships, and dedication to their community. | It’s natural to have questions about what happens next. | What is my business worth? What happens to my employees? What happens to my customers? How long does the process take? And perhaps most importantly, what happens to the business and legacy I worked so hard to build? | At Left Lane Auto, we understand that an acquisition is about much more than completing a transaction. Our goal is to create a thoughtful transition that provides peace of mind for owners while positioning their business for continued success. | Here’s a general look at what you can expect. | Start With a Confidential Conversation | The first step is simply having a conversation. | You don’t have to be ready to sell tomorrow to reach out to Left Lane Auto. Whether you’re actively considering a sale or simply beginning to think about what the future may look like, we’re happy to talk through your goals and answer questions. | We’ll take the time to learn about your business, your history, your team, and what matters most to you. | Learn About Your Business | Every automotive business is different. | We look at the overall picture of your business, including its operations, financial performance, location or locations, customer base, employees, and opportunities for continued growth. | This helps us understand the business and develop an approach that makes sense for both sides. | Discuss the Opportunity | Once we understand your business, we’ll discuss the potential acquisition and the terms of the transaction. | Our goal is to make the process straightforward and transparent so you understand what is being proposed and what the next steps look like. | Develop a Transition Plan | A successful acquisition isn’t just about closing a deal. | It’s about what happens afterward. | At Left Lane Auto, we work to minimize disruption to your employees and customers while creating a plan for a smooth transition. We understand that your employees and customers are a major part of what made your business successful in the first place. | Close and Move Forward | Once the details are finalized, we move toward closing. | Left Lane Auto has experience completing acquisitions on an efficient timeline, with acquisitions possible in as little as 45 days depending on the circumstances. | From there, your next chapter begins—and the business you’ve built continues forward. | Your Legacy Matters | Selling your shop doesn’t mean the story has to end. | For many owners, the right transition means knowing their employees are cared for, their customers will continue receiving quality service, and the business they’ve spent years building has a future. | That’s what we’re committed to at Left Lane Auto. | Thinking about what comes next?
